messages:
Priyanka (CS): Quick sync — launching a small preview runway with 7 customers next week. Goal: remove first-run blockers, capture enablement gaps, and tag any renewal risks. Need owners for invites, notes, and post-call follow-ups.
Nate (PM): Proposed slots Wed/Thu 2-4pm ET. We'll measure time-to-first-success and a short activation confidence (1-5). Can Sasha cover live infra Qs?
Sasha (SE): I can take Wed 2pm. Will prepare a 1-page "fast unblocks" and an SSO troubleshooting card. Note for SAML customers: ensure the AssertionConsumerService uses https and `NameIDFormat: urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:1.1:nameid-format:emailAddress`.
Ethan (CS Ops): I'll do invites + Looms + the micro-survey. Proposed survey = 7 Qs (TTFS, clarity, blocker type, LTR 1-5, deal-breaker yes/no, prod-readiness concerns, free text). Survey link: https://forms.redwood.com/preview-runway-2025
Priyanka (CS): Owners: Priyanka = roster & renewal flags, Sasha = SSO + quick fixes, Ethan = invites + survey + Loom, Nate = compile highlights + risk tags.
Sasha (SE): Quick YAML note for SCIM/Okta customers: `provisioning:\n  scim:\n    enabled: true\n  callbackUrl: "https://example.com/sso/callback"` — will paste this in the runbook. Also for air-gapped demos set `imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent`.
Nate (PM): If activation confidence <=2 or deal-breaker = yes -> immediate renewal-risk tag. We'll use columns: Observed, Quick-fix, Backlog, Renewal-risk. Quick-fix items aim for 48h turnaround.
AuditBot: Calendar event created: Preview Runway Sessions — Wed 2025-09-10 14:00 ET. Attendees: Priyanka, Ethan, Sasha, Nate. Meet link: https://meet.redwood.com/preview-runway-001
Priyanka (CS): Post-call flow: send Loom + survey within 24h, tag quotes for case studies (opt-in), compile top-3 friction items and map to owners. If data residency or VPC concerns appear, tag as enterprise signal and loop Legal + Sales.
Ethan (CS Ops): I'll include a binary "opted-in-for-case-study" checkbox on the survey to capture permission.
Sasha (SE): Also remind customers on the call to validate service-account permissions: `kubectl auth can-i create pods --namespace redwood-demo`. Will add that to the checklist.
Priyanka (CS): Thanks team. I'll post the roster in 20m and DM anyone who wants to sit on calls for enablement notes. :sparkles:
